# Taxoras Advisory & Compliance

> Taxoras Advisory & Compliance is an Indian business accounting, taxation support, and statutory compliance consultancy headquartered in New Delhi. The firm assists micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), startups, retail traders, e-commerce sellers, and independent professionals across India with structured, affordable bookkeeping, GST compliance, TDS return filing, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

## Core Compliance Services
- [GST Registration Assistance](https://www.taxoras.online/services/gst-registration): End-to-end guidance for proprietorships, partnerships, LLPs, and companies crossing statutory thresholds (₹40L for goods / ₹20L for services) or requiring inter-state/e-commerce registrations on gst.gov.in.
- [GST Return Filing Support](https://www.taxoras.online/services/gst-return-filing): Accurate monthly and quarterly filing of Form GSTR-1 (outward supplies) and Form GSTR-3B (tax computation and payment) with invoice validation.
- [GSTR-2B & ITC Reconciliation](https://www.taxoras.online/services/gst-return-filing): Cross-referencing purchase ledgers against auto-drafted GSTR-2B statements to maximize valid Input Tax Credit and prevent reversal notices under Section 16(4).
- [Quarterly TDS Return Filing](https://www.taxoras.online/services/tds-return-filing): Preparation and submission of Form 24Q (Salary TDS) and Form 26Q (Non-Salary vendor payments under 194C, 194J, 194I, 194H) with Challan 281 tracking.
- [Day-to-Day Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://www.taxoras.online/services/daily-accounting): Transaction recording, purchase/sales register upkeep, ledger maintenance, and monthly trial balance preparation using standard accounting principles.
- [Bank Reconciliation (BRS)](https://www.taxoras.online/services/bank-reconciliation): Resolving differences between bank passbooks and general cash ledgers, identifying uncleared cheques, bank fees, and timing mismatches.
- [Debtors & Creditors Reconciliation](https://www.taxoras.online/services/debtors-creditors-reconciliation): Ledger statement matching with trade vendors and customers, balance confirmations, and aging reports.
- [MSME Udyam Registration](https://www.taxoras.online/services/msme-udyam-registration): Complete assistance for micro, small, and medium businesses to obtain official Government Udyam certificates with accurate NIC codes.
- [Balance Sheet & Financial Statements](https://www.taxoras.online/services/balance-sheet): Year-end balance sheets, Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, depreciation schedules, and management reports for banking, loan approvals, and internal review.
- [Income Tax Return Filing Assistance](https://www.taxoras.online/services/income-tax-return): Preparation and e-filing support for salaried employees, professionals, freelancers, and small business owners (ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4 Presumptive under 44AD/44ADA).

## Key Compliance Resources & Educational Guides
- [GST Registration Guide & Checklist](https://www.taxoras.online/resources/gst-registration-india-documents-process): Complete document requirements, TRN generation, and Aadhaar biometric verification.
- [GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B Comparison](https://www.taxoras.online/resources/understanding-gstr-1-and-gstr-3b): Differences in due dates, reporting structures, and payment mechanisms.
- [TDS Compliance Fundamentals](https://www.taxoras.online/resources/what-is-tds-and-when-does-it-apply): Deductor obligations, section thresholds, and quarterly deadlines.
- [Income Tax Preparation Guide](https://www.taxoras.online/resources/how-to-prepare-for-income-tax-return-filing): AIS, Form 26AS, and capital gain statement reconciliation.
- [Bank Reconciliation Explained](https://www.taxoras.online/resources/bank-reconciliation-explained-small-businesses): Step-by-step tutorial on BRS methods for small firms.
- [Udyam Registration Checklist](https://www.taxoras.online/resources/udyam-registration-eligibility-checklist): Eligibility criteria, investment/turnover caps, and official benefits.

## Operational & Regulatory Transparency
- **Non-Government Status**: Taxoras Advisory & Compliance is a private consultancy and is not a government department or affiliated with the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), or Ministry of MSME. All official portals (gst.gov.in, incometax.gov.in, udyamregistration.gov.in) are official Government of India properties.
- **Statutory Limits**: Filing approvals are subject to verification and jurisdiction by statutory government officers. Taxoras coordinates documentation, review, and submission based on client-provided records.
- **Document Confidentiality**: Client financial records, statements, and invoices are held under strict non-disclosure safeguards and handled via encrypted cloud infrastructure.
